insights.content: The student correctly understands that net work equals the change in kinetic energy.
The student incorrectly treats kinetic energy as linear in speed instead of proportional to the square of speed.

output.content: The student knows that net work equals change in kinetic energy and can use an integral, but still needs to explain why variable forces require integration.
The student now applies Newton's first law correctly and explains that constant velocity means zero net force.
